描述_EN: trailing or piping thick tube-like slip has been a near universal technique of decorating pottery. defining the decorative areas with raised slip, the chinese potter was able to prevent glazes from running and blending during firing. in china this type of ware is known as 'fahua'.
描述_ZN: 拖曳或管道式的厚管状滑液是一种几乎普遍的陶器装饰技术。 用凸起的滑液定义装饰区域，中国的陶工能够防止釉在烧制过程中的流动和混合。 在中国，这种类型的器皿被称为 "法华"。
